notes.title: new DEMO on CD-Action Expo 25
notes.notes: [p]Sylwester Osik - Indie game developer publishing as Garage 5 studio, creator of games such as "Electro Ride", "Sunrise GP" and the expo-presented "Do You even Forklift?". In the industry for almost 10 years. Member of Kurka Collective, one of the founders of the Lublin GameDev Foundation.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hi, I'm Sylwek. I've been in the industry for quite a few years, last year I was even one of the panelists. This year I finally have something to brag about. This time I'm working on the game solo, after hours, with a budget of 3kg of coffee and a few pizzas eaten after midnight. I took some assets from old projects, some free ones, and put together a puzzle game about messing around with a forklift. The game participated in the global finals of Game Jam Plus 2024/2025, took 3rd place in Europe and North America, 2nd in the "Mechanic design and core loop" category and 1st in the "Engagement and Fun" category.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://expo.cdaction.pl/indie-mania-garage-5/"]https://expo.cdaction.pl/indie-mania-garage-5/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44275240/c46c42fc951ef26e7f22f2240ead725567da084d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 2 - DEMO update!
notes.notes:
[h1]In this update you will found:[/h1]

- Fixed birds sounds and view audio settings,
- 1 more demo level,
- Fixed Demo endscreen,
- Parking slot doesn't trigger while there is other wrong object in trigger,
- Parking slot doesn't trigger when forklift lifting something.
- More levels has birds and they spawn faster.
- Now you can stack car on car!

And finally!
- Birds now can land on your forklift if you doesnt move!

Have a nice day!
